legend: TdT-positive. Expression of TdT in an otherwise typical diffuse large B-cell lymphoma NOS is rare and does not justify a diagnosis of B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma. A TdT-positive case of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma NOS shows a diffuse proliferation of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei containing prominent nucleoli (<<28977>>).
